line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.13: Prevent perk activation when final resource validation fails.
* Expanded 2.2: Applies to all perks with one-time construction costs. No Food Consumption has been reworked.
* Add-Ons 2.0.1: Fix rename the hacking station. Cannot use RenameResearchStation at this point as the perk is not unlocked yet!
* Mordan2 - change number of lasertower's from 15 to 8 (but increased support fighters to balance)
* Add-Ons 1.13.2: The initial number is now 10 for the player (change the step size from 45 to 36). This lines up with respawn cap of 10.
* Expanded 2.2: Shared one-time perk cost.
* Pay the cost.
* For performance reasons, we create a global array of jump capable outposts for Mayhem.Task.Move.
* Mordan3 - Keep track of how many jump stations we have. One more now.
* Mordan2 - When adding this unique perk, we can add a very cool 3d jump beacon logo above the station to give a nice effect. A few of these custom objects still work. See page 115 MSCI reference.
* This image is real tiny and it sucks, but the selection is really limited and there's no control over it other than placement.
* Add-Ons 1.4.25a: Changed y from y + 1200 to y + 2000 for capital shipyard (y + 1200 was causing in-sector collision with capital shipyard).
* Add-Ons 1.5: Tie these objects to that outpost's local variable. Need to destroy these objects if jump station is destroyed.
* Tutorial reminder. Now called only once rather than every time the player has no jump stations.
